label: diplolepideous
definition: A structural quality inhering in a moss peristome by virtue of its being built from more than one layer of the amphithecium, so that each exostome tooth bears two vertical columns of cell-wall plates on its outer face, usually with an endostome inside the exostome. NOTE: Botany-specific (bryophytes); opposite of haplolepideous. Sibling of FLOPO:0991167 didynamous as a structural quality.
reason: A standard term for moss peristome type with no PATO or FLOPO class. It cannot be broken down into a presence or shape rule.

label: flagelliferous
definition: A structural quality inhering in a shoot system or branch by virtue of its producing flagella: slender, whip-like, often deciduous branches with reduced leaves that serve in vegetative propagation. NOTE: Botany-specific (bryophytes). Would be a presence rule if PO or FLOPO had a flagelliform branch class.
reason: A standard bryological quality. It cannot be a presence rule because no PO or FLOPO class exists for a flagelliform branch.
